stories.story_fr: Morgan Stanley signe un trimestre record au T1 2026 avec un chiffre d'affaires net de 20,6 milliards de dollars et un ROTCE de 27,1 %, le meilleur niveau de son histoire.
stories.story_en: Morgan Stanley posted a record Q1 2026 with net revenues of $20.6B and ROTCE of 27.1%, the highest in its history.
stories.quote: Record first quarter net revenues of $20.6 billion and earnings per diluted share of $3.43.

stories.story_fr: La division Institutional Securities atteint un record historique de 10,7 milliards de dollars de revenus nets au T1 2026, en hausse de 19 % sur un an.
stories.story_en: Institutional Securities division reached a record $10.7B in net revenues in Q1 2026, up 19% year-over-year.
stories.quote: Institutional Securities reported net revenues of $10.7 billion for the quarter.

stories.story_fr: Wealth Management enregistre des revenus record de 7,3 milliards de dollars et une collecte nette de 94 milliards de dollars au T1 2026, portant le total des actifs clients a 6 000 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: Wealth Management reported record revenues of $7.3B and $94B in net new assets in Q1 2026, bringing total client assets to $6 trillion.
stories.quote: Wealth Management reported net revenues of $7.3 billion and net new assets of $94 billion.

stories.story_fr: Les revenus d'Investment Banking progressent de 36 % au T1 2026 a 1,6 milliard de dollars, portes par les conseils en fusions-acquisitions en hausse de 74 %.
stories.story_en: Investment Banking revenues grew 36% in Q1 2026 to $1.6B, driven by advisory fees up 74%.
stories.quote: Investment Banking revenues of $1.6 billion increased 36% year-over-year with advisory revenues up 74%.

stories.story_fr: La division Equity enregistre des revenus records de 5,1 milliards de dollars au T1 2026, en hausse de 25 % sur un an, tiree par la forte activite des clients institutionnels.
stories.story_en: Equity division posted record revenues of $5.1B in Q1 2026, up 25% year-over-year, driven by strong institutional client activity.
stories.quote: Equity net revenues of $5.1 billion were a record, increasing 25% from the prior year period.

stories.story_fr: Le ratio d'efficacite de Morgan Stanley s'ameliore a 65 % au T1 2026, traduisant un levier operationnel marque avec des charges stables malgre la forte croissance des revenus.
stories.story_en: Morgan Stanley's efficiency ratio improved to 65% in Q1 2026, reflecting strong operating leverage with stable costs despite significant revenue growth.
stories.quote: The efficiency ratio for the quarter was 65.0%.
